newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers stable, Mediterranean dips.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers stable, Mediterranean dips.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers were stable on Wednesday as the barge market resisted the losses of other oil products, while Mediterranean bunkers dipped.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were quoted at around $84/85 fob. Total ARA demand was no more than 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were slightly weaker as suppliers tried to compete with Rotterdam. Business was slack, but players said demand looked set to increase at the weekend as a number of ships arrived.
"We're looking to get a few fixtures against Rotterdam. We're quite competitive at the moment," one supplier said.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers prices fell by up to $2 a tonne. Business was slack in all ports.
Middle East bunkers gained about $1 a tonne from the morning, helped up by a flurry of early enquiries.
Saudi Aramco left its fuel oil and gas oil bunker quotes unchanged.
